description.en: Full Korean language pack: registers 한국어 in Settings → General → Language, translates every shipped DeepSeek Harness web GUI dictionary (77 namespaces, 4,253 keys measured against the installed runtime) and applies a scoped Korean typography stack.
description.zh: 完整韩语语言包：在 设置 → 通用 → 语言 注册韩语，翻译 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面全部内置词典（按已安装运行时实测 77 个命名空间、4,253 个键），并应用定制的韩语字体栈。
